requirements.title: Aggregate fleet conformance and distributions
requirements.description: FleetService.ScanFleet rolls up offenders, profile/surface distribution, per-rule conformance, and auto-fixable coverage across discovered scenarios via deterministic structured queries — not a search-hub data provider.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts the scan aggregates rollups and distributions and requires a validation engine.

requirements.title: Fleet scan is resilient to per-scenario errors
requirements.description: A scenario that fails to scan is recorded as an error and the fleet scan continues over the remaining scenarios rather than aborting the whole rollup.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts a failing scenario is recorded and the scan continues.
